name: stark-progress
description: The Gru pane in Gru's tab (a calm board of the run, a log of the big steps in plain words, the stats of Gru and of the whole run, and the settings Gru reads before each launch), and the ticket pane in each Minion and Agnes tab (its one ticket, its log, its stats, and the settings the worker reads before its review, merge and release), and the Super-Gru pane in Super-Gru's tab (the epics in groups by state, its blocked tickets, a log of the steps of Super-Gru and each Gru, the Mega stats of the whole run, the GitHub activity of every epic, and the settings Super-Gru reads), with a progress row above the prompt while it is not placed, read from ~/.cache/stark-progress/
